description: This file provides utility functions for splitting strings into linked list tokens, mainly by whitespace, and includes internal validation logic.

methods.name: split
methods.description: Splits a string into tokens separated by whitespace and adds valid tokens to a linked list.

methods.name: addIfValid
methods.description: Adds a token to the linked list if it is considered valid.

methods.name: isTokenValid
methods.description: Checks whether a token is valid (non-empty).
